metadata.source: Professional Video Prompts.pdf; AI Video Prompt Packs.md
metadata.description: Video editing, generation, production, and workflow prompt cards for review-led, consent-aware workflows.

prompts.title: Cinematic Upgrade
prompts.prompt: Edit this video into a cinematic clip. Keep [subject] unchanged. Improve the lighting to look like [lighting style]. Add [camera movement], [colour style], and [visual mood]. Do not change [what must stay the same].
prompts.best_for: raw footage upgrades and polished social video
acceptance_criteria: The protected subject, scene elements, and constraints are preserved.
The requested change is visually coherent and does not introduce unintended artifacts.
Review the result for consent, brand, and rights requirements before publishing.

prompts.title: Background Replacement
prompts.prompt: Replace the background in this video with [new background]. Keep [subject] exactly as they appear, with the same lighting, movement, and scale. Make the new background match the [mood/time of day] of the original clip.
acceptance_criteria: The protected subject, scene elements, and constraints are preserved.
The requested change is visually coherent and does not introduce unintended artifacts.

prompts.title: Object Removal

prompts.title: Establishing hero shot
prompts.prompt:
SUBJECT: [SUBJECT AND FIXED DETAILS, e.g. a lone architect in a charcoal coat].
ACTION: [ONE BEAT, e.g. walks toward a glass tower as the doors open].
SETTING: [LOCATION], [TIME OF DAY], [WEATHER].
CAMERA: 35mm lens, slow dolly-in at walking pace, eye level, shallow depth of field.
LIGHTING: low sun from camera left, warm 3200K key against cool shadow fill, soft haze catching the rays.
COMPOSITION: subject on the right third, tower filling the left two thirds, leading lines converging on the doors.
NARRATIVE: the viewer should feel arrival and quiet authority by the last frame.
PROTECTED: coat color, silhouette and doorway geometry stay identical.
FORMAT: [9:16 or 16:9], [DURATION] seconds, 24 fps.
AUDIO: Voiceover in [LANGUAGE], [PACE], [VOICE STYLE], reading: "[VO LINE]". Background music: [GENRE AND MOOD], instrumental, ducked under the voice, rising on the final beat.
variables: [SUBJECT AND FIXED DETAILS, e.g. a lone architect in a charcoal coat]
[ONE BEAT, e.g. walks toward a glass tower as the doors open]
acceptance_criteria: Use one visible beat where the template calls for a clip or shot.
Review continuity, hands, lettering, logos, product details, and audio before assembly.
Confirm consent, rights, substantiation, disclosure, and platform requirements before publishing.

NARRATIVE: a private decision lands in the character's expression; end on the held look.
PROTECTED: face shape, wardrobe and hair stay identical across the clip.
FORMAT: [ASPECT], [DURATION] seconds, 24 fps.
AUDIO: [PASTE AUDIO RULE LINE WITH YOUR VO LINE AND MUSIC DIRECTION]

prompts.title: Transition shot between scenes

ACTION: the move ends on a frame that matches the opening frame of [NEXT SCENE].

prompts.title: Shot-list builder (paste into Claude)
prompts.prompt: Act as a cinematographer and prompt engineer. Take this brief: [BRIEF IN ONE PARAGRAPH]. Return a numbered shot list of [N] shots. For each shot write: shot number, duration in seconds, one action beat, lens, camera movement, lighting, composition, narrative purpose, and one voiceover line of 8 to 14 words. Add one music direction for the whole sequence. Return a table, ordered by timeline. Go beyond the basics. Think before answering (maximum reasoning).

prompts.title: Reference audit (paste into Claude with your images)
prompts.prompt: Review the attached reference image(s) for animation readiness. Return a table with these columns: element, risk if animated (identity drift, hand distortion, text warping, logo distortion, geometry), severity 1 to 5, and one fix. Then write the single best image-to-video prompt for the strongest reference, following this anatomy: action beat, camera and lens, environment motion, protected details, ending frame. Flag anything you cannot verify from the image.
acceptance_criteria: Use one visible beat where the template calls for a clip or shot.

prompts.title: Selfie talk-to-camera
prompts.prompt:
SUBJECT: a [AGE RANGE] presenter, [WARDROBE], [HAIR], natural skin texture, holding [PRODUCT] near the lens.
ACTION: speaks directly to camera, one small gesture toward the product at the midpoint.
SETTING: [REAL-LOOKING ROOM, e.g. bright kitchen with a lived-in counter].
CAMERA: front-facing phone camera, 26mm equivalent, arm's-length selfie framing, slight natural hand sway.
LIGHTING: soft window light from screen right, no studio fill, natural skin shine allowed.
COMPOSITION: face in the upper half, product in the lower right, background slightly cluttered and real.
NARRATIVE: the viewer should feel a friend is sharing a find, ending on a relaxed smile.
PROTECTED: product label and packaging text stay readable and unchanged.
FORMAT: 9:16, [DURATION] seconds, 30 fps.
AUDIO: Voiceover in [LANGUAGE], conversational pace, [VOICE STYLE], reading: "[VO LINE]". Background music: [e.g. light lo-fi beat], instrumental, low under the voice, ducked while speaking.

prompts.title: UGC script writer (paste into Claude)
prompts.prompt: Write a [DURATION]-second UGC script for [PRODUCT AND ONE-LINE DESCRIPTION] aimed at [AUDIENCE]. Use only these verified product facts: [FACT 1], [FACT 2], [FACT 3]. Write in first-person creator voice, 6th-grade reading level, [TONE]. Structure: hook (first 1.7 seconds spoken), one specific moment of use, one benefit tied to a verified fact, soft call to action. Return a two-column table: spoken line, on-screen action. Invent no results, numbers or testimonials. Mark any line that needs substantiation with [VERIFY].

prompts.title: Hook batch (paste into Claude)
prompts.prompt: Generate 7 hooks for a UGC ad for [PRODUCT] on [TikTok / Reels / Shorts], one per category in this order: Receipt, Contrarian, Negative Frame, Curiosity Gap, Us-vs-Them, How-To Promise, Pattern Interrupt. prompts.title: Direct-response ad, 20 to 30 seconds
prompts.prompt:
SUBJECT: [PRESENTER DESCRIPTION OR AVATAR REFERENCE] with [PRODUCT].
BEAT 1 (0 to 2 s): hook, spoken to camera: "[HOOK]".
BEAT 2 (2 to 8 s): the problem shown in action: [SHORT SCENE].

prompts.title: Structure at a glance
prompts.prompt:
| Beat | Seconds (30 s cut) | Job | Spoken pattern |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hook | 0 to 2 | Name the problem in the viewer's words | "\[PROBLEM IN ONE SHORT LINE\]" |
| Agitate | 2 to 8 | Show the problem happening | "\[SPECIFIC MOMENT THE VIEWER RECOGNIZES\]" |
| Turn | 8 to 12 | Introduce the product as the change | "\[PRODUCT\] changes that part." |
| Solution | 12 to 24 | Show one verified feature solving it on screen | "\[VERIFIED FEATURE\] means \[PLAIN CONSEQUENCE\]." |
| Call to action | 24 to 30 | One next step | "\[CTA\]" |

prompts.title: Script template, 30 seconds
prompts.prompt:
[0 to 2 s] ON CAMERA: [PRESENTER] with a frustrated half-smile. SPOKEN: "[PROBLEM HOOK]". ON-SCREEN TEXT: "[HOOK TEXT]".
[2 to 8 s] B-ROLL: [PROBLEM MOMENT, handheld, real setting]. SPOKEN: "[AGITATE LINE 1]. [AGITATE LINE 2]."
[8 to 12 s] ON CAMERA: presenter lifts [PRODUCT] into frame, label to lens. SPOKEN: "[TURN LINE]".
[12 to 24 s] DEMO: [VERIFIED FEATURE IN ACTION, close-up, 2 shots]. SPOKEN: "[FEATURE LINE 1]. [FEATURE LINE 2]."
[24 to 30 s] ON CAMERA: relaxed, direct look. SPOKEN: "[CTA]". ON-SCREEN TEXT: "[CTA TEXT]".
AUDIO: Voiceover in [LANGUAGE], conversational, [VOICE STYLE]. Background music: [GENRE], instrumental, tension-light in beats 1 to 2, brighter from the turn onward, ducked under the voice throughout.
LENS AND LIGHT: 26mm phone equivalent, natural window light, no studio fill.

prompts.title: Hands-on demo script, 30 to 40 seconds
prompts.prompt:
[0 to 3 s] ON CAMERA: [PRESENTER] holds [PRODUCT] up. SPOKEN: "[HOOK: what the product does, in one line]".
[3 to 10 s] DEMO SHOT 1, top-down: [SETUP ACTION]. SPOKEN: "[SETUP LINE]".
[10 to 22 s] DEMO SHOT 2, 45 degree angle: [CORE USE ACTION]. SPOKEN: "[CORE USE LINE]". ON-SCREEN LABEL: "[FEATURE NAME]".
[22 to 30 s] DEMO SHOT 3, macro: [DETAIL]. SPOKEN: "[DETAIL LINE]".
[30 to 38 s] ON CAMERA: presenter back to lens. SPOKEN: "[CTA]".
CAMERA: 26mm phone equivalent for talking shots, 50mm equivalent for demo shots, handheld with light stabilization.
LIGHTING: bright natural light from one side, soft shadows under the product, no heavy grade.
COMPOSITION: product always in frame, hands never covering the label for more than 1 second.
NARRATIVE: the viewer sees it work, then knows exactly how to get it.
AUDIO: Voiceover in [LANGUAGE], clear and unhurried, [VOICE STYLE]. Background music: [GENRE], instrumental, ducked under the voice, steady through the demo.
variables: [HOOK: what the product does, in one line]
